title: Give buyers of strata lots the required information before contract
what: Before a buyer signs a contract for a lot in a strata titles scheme, give the buyer the information the Act lists (such as the scheme notice, plan and by-laws), with more where the seller is the scheme developer.

sources.title: Strata Titles Act 1985 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. The duty covers all strata lot sales, not only proposed lots; section 156 adds duties where the scheme developer is the seller (off-the-plan sales). Reach and framework marks follow the Queensland requirement for this family; to check.
